subject: Resolve numtests counter error (#514)
reason: The change only edits src/unit/test_main.c, the main() of Valkey's internal unit-test runner, fixing the array-size computation for the test-suite loop counter. It is test-infrastructure code compiled into the valkey-unit-tests binary and does not alter valkey-server behaviour, any command reply, replication, persistence, or the CLI tools, so no fuzzer scenario can reach or exercise it.
